title: The Soup Served without a Spill
youtube_title: The Soup Served without a Spill | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Finishing together matters more than finishing first.
summary: At a garden row with string and two watering cans, a heavy pot steadied while someone ladled will go wrong if one person rushes. Vera and Uma split it into two slow jobs, while Miss Dalca only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
